difficulty_reason: I-power-torsion objects of the formal category come from ordinary coherent sheaves, with Hom and Ext preserved: an I^c-annihilated system stabilizes at F_c; the Hom comparison computes H^0(X, H) = lim H^0(X, H/I^n H) for the internal hom H = SheafHom(G, F) (completion-internal-hom lemma), giving Mor in the formal category; on Ext, injectivity follows from the Hom bijection and surjectivity realizes a completed extension as G -> E^ via the affine existence lemma part (1). Retained author proof at lines 6786-6826.
